highlights: Integrates AI chat, knowledge base (RAG), workflow orchestration, long/short-term memory, MCP tools, and more — for rapidly building intelligent business assistants.
Knowledge Base (RAG) Supports both vector search and knowledge graph retrieval
AI Workflow Visual editor with conditional branching, parallel execution, and built-in nodes for LLM calls, knowledge base queries, human feedback, and more
MCP Service Marketplace Integrate MCP services to extend AI with external tools and data sources
Mango Finder — A local-first desktop app for semantic search across documents, images, and audio files using natural language, with cross-device search support.
MCP 工具调用：对话中可调用外部工具（如搜索引擎、数据库查询等）
工作流与对话的关系：用户在对话中可调用工作流，工作流内部可以检索知识库和调用 MCP 工具。
MCP 是一种标准化的外部工具接入协议，允许 AI 在对话中调用外部服务。
